set.body: Deferred from UI-S4 and UI-S6 (2026-09-18). StudyFailure.Temporal is refused by the result codec, recording plans and temporal plans are not manifest roles (RecordingPlan is fixed to Px while the resolver is unit-generic; the temporal plan needs a registry), and recording/temporal results have no archive codec, so their fresh-process comparison uses a writer fingerprint outside the saved files. Deliver archive codecs, manifest roles and ArtifactDecoders support, with v1 fixtures and fresh-process coverage.
set.title: Result archives and manifest roles for recording and temporal studies
